# Veil 0.15.0

Minor release for all ten Veil, Shield Swap, and Bridge packages, published
under npm's `latest` tag.

```sh
npm install @provablehq/veil-core@latest @provablehq/veil-aleo-sdk@latest
```

## Changes

- Support Shield-compatible xReserve private USDCx mints for local Aleo
  accounts in `@provablehq/aleo-bridge-sdk`. The SDK reserves a persistent
  counter, derives the secret scalar and BHP256 address commitment from the
  account's view key, checkpoints only the public commitment, and reads the
  scalar back from its identity store when it submits `private_mint`. A quoted
  plan carries its reserved commitment under `plan.circle`, so executing the
  quoted plan deposits against the quoted identity instead of reserving a
  second one.
- Support wallet-prepared private mints. Quote, execute, and resume accept
  `walletPreparedDeposit`; completion accepts the matching
  `privateMintNonceInput` request while the wallet retains the scalar. The SDK
  validates the reviewed wrapper, canonical hook, attested commitment,
  recipient, and nonce-source exclusivity before submission.
- Group every Circle-specific option under a `circle` key on the bridge
  client config and on quote, execute, resume, complete, and recover: the
  identity store, reserved commitment, wallet preparation, nonce input, and
  legacy secret nonce for xReserve, and the manual-mint and
  approval-replacement overrides for CCTP. The flat `privateMintSecretNonce`
  and `cctp` call options are deprecated and still accepted; the same field
  supplied in both forms with different values is rejected.
- Ship `fileXReservePrivateMintIdentityStore` from
  `@provablehq/aleo-bridge-sdk/node`. It replaces files atomically with `0600`
  permissions, backs up the identity file with its `.counter` companion, and
  locks reservations across processes that share a path. Stale-lock recovery
  reclaims only a confirmed dead owner's file; foreign or unrecognized owners
  fail closed.
- Validate store-managed identities before funds move: a quoted identity
  that is absent from the store, or that names a different recipient, is
  rejected before source approval or deposit submission. Standalone actions
  require an explicit shared identity store rather than deriving into a
  temporary one.
- Move `@provablehq/veil-aleo-sdk` and `@provablehq/veil-aleo-devnode` to the
  snarkVM 4.12.0 toolchain: `@provablehq/sdk` 0.13.0 and
  `@provablehq/aleo-devnode` 0.4.0. The default devnode consensus-heights list
  now matches snarkVM's built-in `TEST_CONSENSUS_VERSION_HEIGHTS`, and a
  ready node runs the latest consensus version before the first caller
  transaction. A caller who sets `CONSENSUS_VERSION_HEIGHTS` explicitly MUST
  pass twenty-two heights with the first at 0 and the rest strictly
  increasing.
- Move `@provablehq/veil-aleo-react-hooks` and
  `@provablehq/veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` to the current aleo-dev-toolkit
  adapter releases: `@provablehq/aleo-wallet-adapter-core` 1.2.0, `-react`
  1.4.0, `-shield` 1.4.0, and `-leo`, `-puzzle`, `-fox` 1.1.3.

## Private USDCx mints

A private xReserve mint commits the deposit to a secret scalar that is needed
again at completion. The bridge client takes an identity store as
`circle.privateMintIdentities` and supplies it to quote, execute, and
complete. A client built without one derives into an in-memory store, which
does not survive a restart; a durable deployment MUST pass
`fileXReservePrivateMintIdentityStore` or an implementation of
`XReservePrivateMintIdentityStore` backed by its own storage.

New derivations follow shield-core's mainnet/testnet domain separation.
Identities stored by earlier builds continue to complete with their
originally stored scalars. Transfers quoted on 0.14.0 with the implicit
`0scalar` nonce still complete; pass `circle: { privateMintSecretNonce }` to
keep producing that commitment.

Guide: [private USDCx mints](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/blob/v0.15.0/packages/bridge/docs/private-usdcx-mints.md)
· [wallet-prepared mint example](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/blob/v0.15.0/packages/bridge/examples/wallet-private-mint.ts).

## Validation

The root suite passed 2,724 tests with 314 gated tests skipped across 230
test files. All ten packages build, and the reference dApp typechecks. Packed
peer ranges for `veil-aleo-devnode`, `veil-aleo-sdk`, and
`veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` resolve to `>=0.15.0 <1.0.0`.

Source: [feature PR #166](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/166),
[toolchain PR #197](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/197),
[fix PR #208](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/208).
